name: initiate_asset_recovery
description: initiate_asset_recovery: Initiate recovery of company hardware from a departing employee after their access has been removed. Retrieves the employee's assigned assets and creates a recovery order with pickup or shipping instructions.

case_id.description: The access removal case ID (e.g. CASE-ACCT-072948).

recovery_method.description: How equipment will be recovered. shipping_label = a prepaid label is mailed and the employee ships devices back; drop_off = the employee returns devices in person to an IT office.
